rows.label: bf06130100_0010
rows.name:
We'll go to Luxuria by ship. Once we arrive,
we'll travel overland for a while.

rows.label: bf06130100_0020
rows.name:
So we're traveling with Turtle-chan
here? Never thought I'd see the day...

rows.label: bf06130100_0030
rows.name:
You can relax as though you
were aboard a great ship.

rows.label: bf06130100_0040
rows.name:
Zeke's got bad luck, mo.
Feels like we're going to sink, mo.

rows.label: bf06130100_0080
rows.name:
You said before that Iira concerned
you too... What did you mean by that?

rows.label: bf06130100_0100
rows.name:
I don't know about those guys, but the country of Iira
that fell 500 years ago...

rows.label: bf06130100_0120
rows.name:
The people of Luxuria are descendants of Hero Adel,
who escaped Iira's destruction.

rows.label: bf06130100_0130
rows.name:
So after Homura fell asleep,
Adel went to Luxuria?

rows.label: bf06130100_0160
rows.name: That is the first I've heard of it.

rows.label: bf06130100_0165
rows.name:
I thought I'd studied history fairly well,
but I knew nothing about this.

rows.label: bf06130100_0170
rows.name: We don't really make this sort of thing public.

rows.label: bf06130100_0180
rows.name: Now its only trace is in the royal family's crest.
